profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Corewell Health | Master of Science in Computer Information Systems
profile.summary:
I am a highly skilled Senior Full Stack .NET Developer with over seven years of experience designing, developing, and deploying scalable enterprise applications in the healthcare and mortgage domains. With a strong background in both front-end and back-end development, I specialize in building secure, high-performance solutions using modern Microsoft and cloud technologies.

At Corewell Health, I have designed and developed microservice-based applications using Docker and Azure Kubernetes, which helped improve system scalability and performance during high traffic. I also used Azure Blob Storage for secure and reliable data management. I focus on writing clean, easy-to-maintain code using Test-Driven Development (TDD), which has helped improve code quality and reduce bugs in production.

My main expertise is in .NET technologies like ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, and Azure Cloud Services. On the front end, I’ve worked with Angular, JavaScript, and TypeScript to build fast and responsive user interfaces. I also perform performance testing to make sure applications run smoothly under heavy usage.

I work in Agile environments and have experience with CI/CD pipelines to automate builds and deployments. I enjoy solving complex technical challenges and always look for ways to improve my skills and the systems I develop.

Let’s connect if you’re looking for a dedicated Full Stack Developer who loves building secure, scalable, and high-quality software solutions.
